conclusion: Bounded NLL continuation tests plateau; motion subsets expose nontrivial errors; frozen proximity counts quantify available context without implying causal interactions.

evidence_chain.extension: four full-VAL FDE lines from CSV, original best reference
evidence_chain.interaction: distance histogram + unique pair counts + type-wise mean neighbors from frozen t0 graphs

risks: single seed and VAL selection; bounded continuation is not proof of global optimum
